acceptanceCriteria: Literal include-call arguments bind to shared_examples block parameters for subject/let/expectation analysis, pinned by a test; non-literal arguments abstain with a named code.
body: Residual of V1-1866/V1-1867 (PR #1166, head 8a21fb19c, GH #1163/#1164). Inclusion-qualified evaluation splices the shared body into the including context but does not bind the shared group's block parameters to the include call's arguments, so such examples abstain or are read without those bindings.
title: RSpec inclusion evaluation: bind shared_examples block parameters and it_behaves_like arguments into the spliced body
